description: Namespace per org, default-deny NetworkPolicy (egress allowed; no pod-to-pod across namespaces), ResourceQuota/LimitRange, gVisor enforced by admission policy. Metering: pod-seconds x requested vCPU/mem from Knative/kube events into edge_container_usage so billing (EdgeContainerComputeCost) works unchanged.
title: Isolation + metering for dedicated compute
